name: Computer Vision & Visual Deep Learning
description: Architectures, loss functions, augmentations, and modern neural vision modeling from CNNs to Vision Transformers.

subskills.name: CNN Architectures & Modern Backbones (ResNet, ConvNeXt)
subskills.description: Residual connections, bottleneck blocks, depthwise separable convolutions, and modern ConvNeXt/EfficientNet backbones.

subskills.name: Vision Transformers (ViT, Swin, Patch Embeddings)
subskills.description: Patch partitioning, linear projection of flattened patches, multi-head self-attention on images, Swin hierarchical shifted windows.

subskills.name: Object Detection & Localization (YOLO, Faster R-CNN)
subskills.description: Anchor boxes, region proposal networks (RPN), single-stage vs two-stage detectors, Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS), and mAP calculation.

subskills.name: Semantic & Instance Segmentation (U-Net, Mask R-CNN)
subskills.description: Encoder-decoder architectures with skip connections, pixel-level classification, RoIAlign, and mask prediction heads.

subskills.name: Image Augmentation & Synthetic Perturbation (Albumentations)
subskills.description: Geometric transformations, color jittering, CutMix, MixUp, AutoAugment, and RandAugment for vision regularization.

subskills.name: Vision Transfer Learning & Backbone Fine-Tuning
subskills.description: Pretrained ImageNet weights, progressive unfreezing, discriminative learning rates, and linear probing vs end-to-end fine-tuning.

subskills.name: Vision Loss Functions (Focal Loss, Dice Loss, IoU Loss)
subskills.description: Class imbalance handling in dense prediction, Focal loss for hard examples, Dice loss, and Generalized IoU loss.

subskills.name: Self-Supervised & Multimodal Vision (CLIP, DINO, SimCLR)
subskills.description: Contrastive image-text pretraining, self-distillation without labels (DINO v1/v2), and representation learning.

subskills.name: Spatial-Temporal Video & Sequence Modeling
subskills.description: 3D Convolutions (C3D, I3D), VideoMAE, temporal attention, and action recognition pipelines.

github.signal: Uses Albumentations and torchvision transforms for image pipeline
Implements ResNet, ConvNeXt, or ViT backbone models
Trains YOLO or Faster R-CNN object detection pipelines
